Installs the dsh-TUI terminal-UI plugin (@deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui
0.13.0) into the `dsh-tui` profile of the DeepSeek Harness and exposes
it as a typed terminal channel. The candy ships a package.json pinning
the plugin, which the npm builder installs globally under
NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX (~/.npm-global) so the `dsh-tui` / `dst` launcher is
on PATH; it composes the `dsh` CLI candy (which requires nodejs
>=22.19.0 and pnpm >=10 — dsh plugin delegates installs to pnpm). The
TUI is added to the profile by `dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add …`
at build time, so a fresh container needs no network to launch it.
The first-run wizard is pre-recorded and the launchpad disabled, so
the TUI lands on the chat screen deterministically; the published
terminal_profile + agent_provide tmux channel let a disposable R10
bed launch, snapshot, type into, and read the TUI. The candy writes
the `ollama-cloud` LLM route to `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`; the route
authenticates with OLLAMA_API_KEY from the dsh credential store (the
launch environment, `~/.dsh/.env`, or the config UI) — the key is not
part of this candy and a provider turn needs it. Every fact is
observable: the dsh-tui launcher at ~/.npm-global/bin/dsh-tui, the
profile manifest at $DSH_HOME/profiles/dsh-tui/package.json,
`dsh-tui version` printing the launcher AND profile versions, and the
plugin listed by `dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui list`.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | create the dsh-tui prefs directory |
| `run` | pre-record the dsh-TUI first-run wizard so the channel reaches the chat screen deterministically |
| `run` | pre-record the dsh-TUI workspace home as seen so the channel boots the chat composer, not the first-run home |
| `run` | install the ollama-cloud LLM route as the dsh home-level patch (applies to every profile) |
| `run` | run the auto-detected npm builders (install the dsh CLI + the dsh-tui launcher globally) |
| `run` | add the dsh-TUI plugin to the dsh-tui profile so a fresh container needs no network to launch it |
| `check` | the dsh-tui launcher is installed into the npm global bin directory |
| `check` | the dsh-tui plugin is unpacked under the npm global lib directory |
| `check` | the dsh-TUI plugin is added to the dsh-tui profile at build time |
| `check` | the launchpad is disabled so the terminal channel reaches the composer |
| `check` | the first-run wizard is recorded so the channel does not open on it |
| `check` | the workspace home is recorded as seen so the channel boots the composer on first launch |
| `check` | running dsh-tui version exits cleanly and reports the launcher and profile versions |
| `check` | running dsh-tui help exits cleanly and prints the command surface |
